We decided to use the normalized value instead of the quantity - and divided by Isoform number.
```{r classIIIpeptideCalc2}
ClassIII_calc_Norm2 <- function(Main_output_filtered_peptides, DT, Switches_df, all_samples_isolate) {
  
results <- data.frame(ENSG = as.character(), MeanCancer = as.numeric(), MeanNormal = as.numeric(), p_value = as.numeric())

for (eachPeptide in unique(Main_output_filtered_peptides$Stripped.Sequence)) {
  
  ENSG_id  <- DT[DT$Stripped.Sequence == eachPeptide, 'Genes']$Genes[1]
  # we should only look at the common samples - and isolate those

  Samples_w_ensg <- Switches_df[Switches_df$ENSG == ENSG_id, 'SampleID']
  sample_ids_found <- sapply(strsplit(Samples_w_ensg, "/"), "[", 2)
  samples_ids_nonfound <- setdiff(all_samples_isolate, sample_ids_found)
  
  sample_ids_found_quantity <- DT[DT$Sampleid %in% sample_ids_found & DT$Stripped.Sequence ==  eachPeptide, 'NormalizedByGene']


  
  if (length(sample_ids_found_quantity$NormalizedByGene) > 1 ) {
    
    Isoform <- DT[DT$Sampleid %in% sample_ids_found & DT$Stripped.Sequence ==  eachPeptide, 'Protein.Ids']$Protein.Ids
    NumberofIsoforms <- length(strsplit(Isoform, ';')[[1]])
  
    sample_ids_found_quantity2 <- (sample_ids_found_quantity$NormalizedByGene)/NumberofIsoforms
    
    sample_ids_found_quantity_mean <- mean(sample_ids_found_quantity2)
  } else if (length(sample_ids_found_quantity$NormalizedByGene) == 1) {
    sample_ids_found_quantity_mean <- 'OneSample'
  } else {
    sample_ids_found_quantity_mean <- NA
  }
  
  sample_ids_nonfound_quantity <- DT[DT$Sampleid %in% samples_ids_nonfound & DT$Stripped.Sequence ==  eachPeptide, 'NormalizedByGene',]
  
  if(length(sample_ids_nonfound_quantity$NormalizedByGene) > 1 ) {
    
    Isoform <- DT[DT$Sampleid %in% samples_ids_nonfound & DT$Stripped.Sequence ==  eachPeptide, 'Protein.Ids']$Protein.Ids
    
    NumberofIsoforms <- length(strsplit(Isoform, ';')[[1]])
  
    sample_ids_nonfound_quantity2 <- (sample_ids_nonfound_quantity$NormalizedByGene)/NumberofIsoforms
    
    sample_ids_nonfound_quantity_mean <- mean(sample_ids_nonfound_quantity2)
    
  } else if (length(sample_ids_nonfound_quantity$NormalizedByGene) == 1){
    sample_ids_nonfound_quantity_mean <- 'OneSample'
  } else {
    sample_ids_nonfound_quantity_mean <- NA
  }

  if(length(sample_ids_found_quantity$NormalizedByGene) > 1 & length(sample_ids_nonfound_quantity$NormalizedByGene) > 1) {
   testing <- wilcox.test(as.numeric(unlist(sample_ids_found_quantity2)), as.numeric(unlist(sample_ids_nonfound_quantity2)), alternative = "two.sided", paired = FALSE, exact = NULL, correct = TRUE)
   p_value <- testing$p.value
  } else {
    p_value <- NA
    
  }
  
  results_eachPeptide <- data.frame(ENSG = ENSG_id, Peptide = eachPeptide, MeanCancer = sample_ids_found_quantity_mean, MeanNormal = sample_ids_nonfound_quantity_mean, p_value = p_value)

  results <- rbind(results, results_eachPeptide)  

} 
  return(results)
  
  }
```

```{r NormalizeAllPeptideExpbyGene}
DT_AML_SumStrippedSequence <- DT_AML %>% dplyr::select(Sampleid, Protein.Ids, Genes, Precursor.Normalised, Stripped.Sequence) %>% dplyr::group_by(Sampleid, Protein.Ids, Genes, Stripped.Sequence) %>% dplyr::mutate(AvgNormalised = mean(Precursor.Normalised)) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(Sampleid, Protein.Ids, Genes, Stripped.Sequence, AvgNormalised) %>% dplyr::distinct()

DT_Normalized_AML <- DT_AML_SumStrippedSequence %>% dplyr::select(Protein.Ids, Genes, AvgNormalised, Stripped.Sequence, Sampleid) %>% dplyr::distinct() %>% dplyr::group_by(Sampleid, Genes) %>% dplyr::mutate(NormalizedByGene = AvgNormalised/sum(AvgNormalised))
```



```{r CategoriseENSPs}

for (eachrow in 1:nrow(ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_proteinIds)) { 
  protein_ids <- ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_proteinIds[eachrow, 'Protein.Ids']
  protein_ids_vector <- unlist(str_split(protein_ids, ';'))
  
  # Check if any protein ID is in exclude_ids or include_ids
  in_MDT <- any(protein_ids_vector %in% exclude_ids)
  in_cMDT <- any(protein_ids_vector %in% include_ids)
  
  if (in_MDT & !in_cMDT) {
    ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_proteinIds$description[eachrow] <- "MDT, not cMDT"
  } else if (!in_MDT & in_cMDT) {
    ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_proteinIds$description[eachrow] <- "cMDT, not MDT" # This should not be found considering that they are Class II peptides - as a control!
  } else if (in_MDT & in_cMDT) {
    ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_proteinIds$description[eachrow] <- "MDT and cMDT"
  } else {
    ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_proteinIds$description[eachrow] <- "Other isoforms"
  }
}
```

## 4 category search
```{r Categories1_3}
# MDT specific peptide doesn’t change, cMDT specific changes
# This category is looking at the isoforms that have both 'MDT, not cMDT' and 'cMDT and MDT' categories
valid_ENSGs <- ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_ClassIII %>% dplyr::select(Peptide, ENSG, MeanCancer, MeanNormal, p_value, FDR_new, Protein.Ids, description) %>% dplyr::group_by(ENSG) %>% dplyr::summarise(has_both = all(c('MDT and cMDT', 'MDT, not cMDT') %in% description)) %>% dplyr::filter(has_both) %>% dplyr::pull(ENSG)

Category1_3_Categories <-  ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_ClassIII %>%
  filter(ENSG %in% valid_ENSGs) %>% dplyr::filter(description %in% c('MDT and cMDT', 'MDT, not cMDT'))
```


```{r Category1}
# Define FDR significance threshold
fdr_threshold <- 0.1

# Identify ENSG values where 'MDT, not cMDT' has significant FDR and 'MDT and cMDT' has no change
# category 2
genes_with_significant_change <- Category1_3_Categories %>%
  group_by(ENSG) %>%
  summarise(
    has_significant_not_cMDT = any(FDR_new[description == "MDT, not cMDT"] <= fdr_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_no_significant_cMDT = all(FDR_new[description == "MDT and cMDT"] %>% na.omit() > fdr_threshold)
  ) %>%
  filter(has_significant_not_cMDT & has_no_significant_cMDT) %>%
  pull(ENSG)

# category 1
genes_with_significant_change_ctg1 <- Category1_3_Categories %>%
  group_by(ENSG) %>%
  summarise(
    has_significant_not_cMDT = any(FDR_new[description == "MDT, not cMDT"] > fdr_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_no_significant_cMDT = all(FDR_new[description == "MDT and cMDT"] %>% na.omit() <= fdr_threshold)
  ) %>%
  filter(has_significant_not_cMDT & has_no_significant_cMDT) %>%
  pull(ENSG)

# category 3
genes_with_significant_change_ctg3 <- Category1_3_Categories %>%
  group_by(ENSG) %>%
  summarise(
    has_significant_not_cMDT = any(FDR_new[description == "MDT, not cMDT"] <= fdr_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_no_significant_cMDT = all(FDR_new[description == "MDT and cMDT"] %>% na.omit() <= fdr_threshold)
  ) %>%
  filter(has_significant_not_cMDT & has_no_significant_cMDT) %>%
  pull(ENSG)

# Filter the dataframe to retain only these genes
Category1 <- Category1_3_Categories %>%
  filter(ENSG %in% genes_with_significant_change_ctg1)

Category2 <- Category1_3_Categories %>%
  filter(ENSG %in% genes_with_significant_change)

Category3 <- Category1_3_Categories %>%
  filter(ENSG %in% genes_with_significant_change_ctg3)
```

```{r Category4}
valid_ENSGs_only_not_cMDT <- ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_ClassIII %>%
  dplyr::select(Peptide, ENSG, MeanCancer, MeanNormal, p_value, FDR_new, Protein.Ids, description) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ENSG) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    has_not_cMDT = any(description == 'MDT, not cMDT'),
    has_cMDT = any(description == 'MDT and cMDT'),
    has_only_Normal = any(!is.na(MeanNormal) & is.na(MeanCancer))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(has_not_cMDT & !has_cMDT) %>%
  dplyr::pull(ENSG)

Category4 <-  ClassIII_AML_fdr_only_ClassIII %>%
  filter(ENSG %in% valid_ENSGs_only_not_cMDT) %>%
  filter(
    !(MeanNormal == "NA" | MeanNormal == "OneSample") & 
    (is.na(MeanCancer) | MeanCancer != "OneSample") &
    # Remove cases where MeanNormal is "NA"
    !(MeanNormal == "OneSample" & MeanCancer == "NA")  &
      (is.na(FDR_new) | FDR_new <= 0.1) # Remove cases where MeanNormal is "OneSample" and MeanCancer is "NA"
  )
```
